_note: Draft English of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Bereshit 36 (Esau's lineage; Edomite kings). Saadia-specific: v.8 'אלאחמרי' = 'the Red One' (= Edom; consistent w/ B25:30); v.15 'צנדיד' = 'chieftain' (Saadia's gloss for אלוף); v.20 'אלחוריין' = 'the Horites' transliterated; v.33 'אלבצרה' = Bosra; v.34 'בלד אלימן' = 'land of Yemen' (Saadia identifies תימני); v.37 'רחבת אלפראת' = 'Rehoboth of the Euphrates' for רחובות הנהר.

translations.1: And this is the exposition of the offspring of Esau — he is Edom.
translations.2: And Esau took wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah, daughter of Elon the Hittite; and Oholibamah, daughter of Anah, daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
translations.3: and Basemath, daughter of Ishmael, sister of Nebayot.
translations.4: And Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau; and Basemath bore Reuel.
translations.5: And Oholibamah bore Yeush, and Yalam, and Korah — these are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
translations.6: Then Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and every soul of his household, and his cattle and his beasts, and all his property which he had acquired in the land of Canaan; and he went to another land, away from Jacob his brother.
translations.7: For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together; and the land of their sojourning could not support them, because of their cattle.
translations.8: And Esau — who is the Red One (Edom) — settled in Mount al-Sharah (Seir).
translations.9: And this is the exposition of the offspring of Esau, the father of the Reds (Edomites), in Mount al-Sharah.
translations.10: These are the names of the sons of Esau: Eliphaz, son of Adah his wife; Reuel, son of Basemath his wife.
translations.11: And the sons of Eliphaz were: Teman, Omar, Zefo, Gaatam, and Kenaz.
translations.12: And Timna was a concubine to Eliphaz, son of Esau; and she bore him Amalek. These are the sons of Adah, Esau's wife.
translations.13: And these are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.
translations.14: And these were the sons of Oholibamah, daughter of Anah, daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife — and she bore him: Yeush, and Yalam, and Korah.
translations.15: These are the chieftains of Esau's sons. Sons of Eliphaz, Esau's firstborn: Chief Teman, Chief Omar, Chief Zefo, and Chief Kenaz,
translations.16: and Chief Korah, Chief Gaatam, and Chief Amalek. These are the chieftains from Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Adah.
translations.17: And these are the chieftains of Reuel, son of Esau: Chief Nahath, Chief Zerah, Chief Shammah, Chief Mizzah. These are his chieftains in the land of Edom — and they are the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.
translations.18: And these are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau's wife: Chief Yeush, Chief Yalam, Chief Korah. These are the chieftains of Oholibamah, daughter of Anah, his wife.
translations.19: These are the sons of Esau, and these are their chieftains; and they are the Reds (Edomites).
translations.20: And these are the sons of Seir the Horite, the dwellers of the land: Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,
translations.21: and Dishon, and Etzer, and Dishan. These are the chieftains of the Horites, sons of Seir, in the land of Edom.
translations.22: And the sons of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister was Timna.
translations.23: And these are the sons of Shobal: Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shefo, and Onam.
translations.24: And these are the sons of Zibeon: Ayyah, and Anah. He is the Anah who rode the mules in the wilderness, when he was pasturing the donkeys of Zibeon his father.
translations.25: And these are the sons of Anah: Dishon, and Oholibamah his daughter.
translations.26: And these are the sons of Dishan: Hemdan, and Eshban, and Yitran, and Keran.
translations.27: And these are the sons of Etzer: Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.
translations.28: And these are the sons of Dishan: Uz, and Aran.
translations.29: These are the chieftains of the Horites: Chief Lotan, Chief Shobal, Chief Zibeon, Chief Anah,
translations.30: and Chief Dishon, Chief Etzer, Chief Dishan. These are the chieftains of the Horites in the land of al-Sharah.
translations.31: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom — before a king reigned for the children of Israel.
translations.32: And there reigned in Edom Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
translations.33: Then he died; and there reigned after him Yovav, the son of Zerah, from Bozrah.
translations.34: And Yovav died; and there reigned after him Husham, from the land of Yemen.
translations.35: And Husham died; and there reigned after him Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck the Midianites in the field of Moab; and the name of his city was Avith.
translations.36: And he died; and there reigned after him Samlah, from Masrekah.
translations.37: And he died; and there reigned after him Saul, from Rehoboth-of-the-Euphrates.
translations.38: And he died; and there reigned after him Baal-Hanan, the son of Akhbor.
translations.39: And he died; and there reigned after him Hadar; and the name of his city was Pa'u; and the name of his wife was Mehetabel, daughter of Matred, daughter of Mei-Zahab.
translations.40: And after that, these are the chieftains of Esau according to their clans, in their places by their names: Chief Timna, Chief Alvah, Chief Yetheth,
translations.41: and Chief Oholibamah, Chief Elah, Chief Pinon,
translations.42: and Chief Kenaz, Chief Teman, Chief Mibtzar,
translations.43: and Chief Magdiel, Chief Iram. These are the chieftains of the Reds (Edomites), in their dwellings in the land of their possession — that is Esau, the father of them all.
